subject: Why is there light before the sun?
preview: Genesis 1 is far more careful than most people realize.
linkText: Genesis 1 Explained: The Creation of the World

blocks.text: You have probably heard Genesis 1 argued about more than you have heard it read.
Six days or millions of years.
Science or faith.
Somebody online is always sure.
But have you ever sat down and read the whole chapter, start to finish?
It only takes a few minutes.
And when you do, you start noticing things.
Light shows up on day one. The sun does not show up until day four.
That is not a mistake. The text is deliberate about it.
Then there is the pattern hiding in plain sight.
Days one through three form the spaces. Light and dark, sky and sea, land and plants.
Days four through six fill those same spaces, in the same order.
God builds the rooms before He moves anything into them.
And on day six, He does something He has not done for anything else He made.
"So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them."
No star. No animal. Only the man and the woman, both equally.
You are not an accident. You were made in God's image, on purpose.
And before anyone had done a single thing, God looked at it all and called it very good.
Your worth started there. Not with anything you accomplish.
So I put together a plain English walkthrough of Genesis 1.
📅 What happens on each of the six days, in order
🌅 Why light shows up before the sun
👤 What it means to be made in God's image
📖 Why John 1 opens with the same words as Genesis 1
It is a chapter overview, so you can see the whole shape of the week before you study it one verse at a time.
